notes: Smartphone commit-only release. Q4 is the default Depth Anything V2 Small model. The camera input path now uses ONNX Runtime Tensor.fromImage(ImageData) for authoritative RGBA->RGB/NCHW packing and ImageNet normalization; the predicted_depth output is read with Tensor.getData() so WebGPU gpu-buffer outputs are explicitly downloaded to CPU. The worker follows the official [batch,height,width] depth layout with no heuristic transpose/last-plane interpretation. The neural preview keeps an independent approximately 1 Hz ticker and the official Q4 model is downloaded/cached at runtime when not present locally.
